text:
Aisha: Quick sync — we're doing a dry run of the connector activation ops playbook for Snowbridge (Snowflake) + Databricks + Qdrant. Need eng + field + devex. Goal: validate provisioning, telemetry, sample dataflow, and marketplace entitlement toggles. Proposed window Tue 9am PT. Who can join? :calendar:
Mike: I can do Tue 9am PT. We'll need a standby GPU node for perf smoke (prefer T4/GPU pool or Aurora instances). Also call out the Qdrant shard sizing.
Lina: I'll run the onboarding script and validate doc steps. Can you drop the playbook link?
Aisha: Playbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFR-4321 (activation ops playbook). Key checklist: creds, region parity, manifest, telemetry hooks, billing SKU mapping, marketplace entitlement toggle.
Jordan: I'll test SI install flow with partner cert image. Need sample dataset + schema. Can we use 'retail-sample-v3' or should we synth a smaller set?
Mike: Use retail-sample-v3 but keep it anonymized. Note for Qdrant we need vector shard config change. Quick CLI we will use:
```bash
rwctl connector provision --partner qdrant --region us-east-1 --sku preview --sample-data retail-sample-v3
```
Sarah: Legal note — please ensure the dry run doesn't expose PII. Use anonymized or synthetic data and flag any telemetry that could contain identifiers. Also confirm marketplace contract checkbox is checked before the listing toggle.
Lina: Will generate synthetic dataset and stage it: s3://redwood-test/synthetic/retail-v3/
Aisha: I'll send the calendar invite and create a temporary channel for run artifacts. @deploy-bot can you create the channel and capture logs?
deploy-bot: Created channel #dryrun-1888888888 and started log collection. Artifacts will be archived to /artifacts/dryrun/1888888888.tar.gz :package:
Jordan: On the telemetry side — @mike.eng please add tags 'partner_id' and 'marketplace_sku' to spans so we can slice in Console. Also include a custom metric 'connector_activation_time_ms'.
Mike: Will add tags and metric. Also plan to enable a canary routing rule to fallback to a CPU-quantized model if GPU capacity isn't available.
Aisha: Pre-checks — react with :white_check_mark: when done:
- creds in vault
- sample data staged
- staging cluster provisioned
- manifest validated
- legal signoff
Lina: :white_check_mark:
Jordan: :white_check_mark:
Mike: :white_check_mark:
Sarah: :white_check_mark:
Aisha: Great — I'll run the dry run on Tue 9am PT and post a short postmortem with action items. If we hit infra blockers, I'll escalate to eng-oncall. Thanks everyone!
